BRIGHTRIVER TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD.
EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

Date: October 20, 2026
To: Arjun Mehta
Subject: Offer of Employment — Software Engineer

Dear Arjun,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Software Engineer at BrightRiver Technologies Pvt. Ltd. We were impressed by your experience and believe you will be a strong addition to our engineering team.

Your annual base salary will be INR 12,00,000 (Indian Rupees Twelve Lakh only), paid in accordance with the company's normal payroll schedule and subject to applicable deductions.

In addition to your base salary, you will be eligible for a one-time joining bonus of INR 75,000, payable with your second month's salary subject to the terms of the company's bonus policy.

Your anticipated start date is November 16, 2026. Please accept this offer by October 30, 2026 by signing and returning a copy of this letter.

Before your start date, please provide a copy of your government-issued identification and your highest educational certificate to the People Operations team.

Your reporting manager will be Elena Rodriguez, Engineering Manager. Your primary place of work will be BrightRiver Technologies' Bengaluru office, with the company's standard hybrid-work arrangement.

This offer is subject to completion of the company's standard background and employment verification process and your agreement to the company's applicable employment policies.

If you have questions about this offer, please contact Elena Rodriguez at peopleops@brightriver.example.

We look forward to welcoming you to BrightRiver Technologies.

Sincerely,
Elena Rodriguez
Engineering Manager
BrightRiver Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
